scope: offline accepted-result ledger, source-coverage, and transition verification; no service state, training log, checkpoint payload, unaccepted output, GPU, or intermediate metric accessed
checks_per_accepted_result: program reference path, SHA-256, status, pair, arm, and frozen order
qualified v2 result identity, token total, cadence, and zero-permitted-nonfinite invariant
exact finite 11-source dictionary at all five validation points
matching v2 transition completed run and result path/hash
no polling, quality branching, or automatic retry transition flags
exact successor edge from the 12-cell order
checks_per_ledger: control-first result prefix and bounded six-plus-six counts
target absent before six controls and pinned afterward
analysis absent before six candidates and pinned afterward
program status and next_run agree with accepted-result count
latest transition next_run agrees with the program
transition inventory equals accepted result inventory
interrupted attempt and identical rerun history remain present

failure_policy.required_action: retain the committed evidence, stop interpretation, and diagnose the exact failed invariant without altering scientific thresholds or accepted bytes

decision.next_action: after each final-summary transition, run the verifier against the committed program before interpreting or reporting the result; leave the v2 runner byte-identical

verification.live_empty_ledger_result: valid with 0 accepted results and control pair 0 next

non_claims: the acceptance verifier is part of the frozen automatic finalizer
an empty-ledger check validates a future model result
passing core result hashes substitutes for complete source coverage
the sidecar authorizes result rewriting, retry, skipping, branching, or promotion
